title: TimSpik Basics
description: Modpack that enhances the Vanilla graphical experience without altering the core mechanics.
body:
# 🌿 TimSpik Basics

This mod pack is designed to enhance and expand the Vanilla Minecraft experience without losing its original essence. Its main goal is to provide smoother, more immersive, and enjoyable gameplay for the TimSpik survival server, while maintaining a perfect balance between performance, stability, and authenticity.

![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a75b5ff619fcc8b05573650c70d9f85c91f2004.jpeg)

---

## ✨ Features

- 🧱 **Vanilla-Friendly Improvements** – Keeps the original feel of Minecraft while upgrading visuals and performance.  
- 🌄 **Enhanced Graphics** – Subtle visual upgrades like better lighting, shadows, and environment detail.  
- ⚙️ **Optimized Performance** – Carefully selected mods to improve FPS and stability.  
- 🕹️ **Seamless Gameplay** – No changes to core mechanics — everything still feels 100% Vanilla.  
- 💬 **Multiplayer Ready** – Fully compatible with the TimSpik Survival Server.

---

## 🔧 Technical Details

- **Minecraft Version:** 1.21.10 
- **Mod Loader:** Fabric.
- **Performance Mods:** Sodium, Lithium, Starlight, etc.  
- **Visual Mods:** Complementary Shaders, Effective, Iris, etc.  
- **Utility Mods:** Zoom, Minimaps, and QoL tweaks.

---

## 💡 Philosophy

> “Vanilla+, not Vanilla lost.”  
> The pack is made for players who love Minecraft’s original feel but want a more refined, modern experience — perfect for long-term survival worlds.
